# MiraCluster

**For:** anyone writing the custom resource the operator reconciles.

`mira.miradb.dev/v1alpha1`, namespaced, short name `mira`. The schema below is
the one the API server stores, which is the one that decides what
survives a write: a field it does not name is **pruned** on apply, with
no error anywhere.

Installing it is [Install](../install.md#kubernetes); what the operator builds
out of it, and how a scale-in is sequenced, is the
[chart reference](chart.md).

## `spec`

A Mira storage tier and the proxy in front of it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it sets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `coldStorageClaim` | string | unset | Name of an existing claim holding the cold store, mounted into the drain Job at the first path segment of `offload`. |
| `image` | string | required | The Mira image the storage pods and the drain Jobs both run. |
| `maxReplicas` | integer ≥ 1 | `10` | Replica ceiling. Scale-out stops here rather than filling the cluster. |
| `offload` | string | unset | Where a drained replica's blocks are copied before its volume is deleted. `${node}` interpolates to the replica name. |
| `proxy` | object | — | The `mira proxy` tier that fans out across the replicas. |
| `proxy.replicas` | integer | `2` | How many proxy pods. Zero disables the proxy entirely and leaves the storage pods addressable only through the headless Service. |
| `proxy.resources` | ResourceRequirements | unset | CPU and memory for one proxy pod. |
| `replicas` | integer ≥ 1 | `1` | Replica floor. The tier never shrinks below this. |
| `resources` | ResourceRequirements | unset | CPU and memory for one storage replica, and for the drain Job that archives its volume. |
| `route` | object | unset | An `HTTPRoute` in front of the tier, attached to Gateways you already run. |
| `route.hostnames` | array | unset | Hostnames the route answers on. Unset answers on every hostname its listener accepts. |
| `route.parentRefs` | array | required | The Gateways to attach to. At least one, or the route binds to nothing and the apiserver accepts it anyway. |
| `route.parentRefs[].name` | string | required | `metadata.name` of the Gateway. |
| `route.parentRefs[].namespace` | string | unset | The Gateway's namespace. Unset is this `MiraCluster`'s own. |
| `route.parentRefs[].sectionName` | string | unset | `spec.listeners[].name` to attach to. Unset attaches to every listener that will have it. |
| `scaling` | object | — | When to add a replica, and when to take one away. |
| `scaling.cooldownSeconds` | integer | `600` | Seconds after any scaling action before another may be considered. |
| `scaling.downWhenFreeAbove` | number | `0.6` | Remove a replica when *every* replica's `free_fraction` is above this. |
| `scaling.drainDeadlineSeconds` | integer | `3600` | Seconds a drain Job may run before Kubernetes fails it. |
| `scaling.upWhenFreeBelow` | number | `0.15` | Add a replica when the *fullest* replica's `free_fraction` drops below this. |
| `storage` | object | required | Per-replica volume. |
| `storage.className` | string | unset | StorageClass. Unset uses the cluster default. |
| `storage.size` | quantity | required | Volume size, as a Kubernetes quantity — `100Gi`. |

## `status`

A subresource, so the operator writes it without touching the spec, and an
unsatisfiable spec lands here rather than in a log line nobody reads.

| Field | Type | Default | What it reports |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `draining` | integer | unset | Replica ordinal currently being drained, if any. Set before the drain Job is created and cleared only once the volume has been released, so a controller restart mid-drain resumes rather than abandoning a half-copied tier. |
| `freeFraction` | string | unset | The lowest `free_fraction` seen across the tier, rendered to two decimals. A string and not a float because this is a `printcolumn`, and `kubectl` renders a float64 status field in scientific notation. |
| `lastScaled` | string | unset | RFC3339 of the last completed scaling action, for the cooldown. |
| `message` | string | unset | Human-readable reason for the current phase. |
| `phase` | string | unset | `Ready`, `ScalingUp`, `Draining` or `Degraded`. |
| `replicas` | integer | `0` | Replica count the operator is currently asking for. |

## Refused on write

Enforced by the API server rather than by the operator, so the `kubectl`
that would break the tier fails instead of the reconcile that follows it.

| Rule | Message |
| --- | --- |
| `self.spec.maxReplicas >= self.spec.replicas` | maxReplicas must be at least replicas |

## `kubectl get miraclusters`

| Column | Read from |
| --- | --- |
| Replicas | `.status.replicas` |
| Free | `.status.freeFraction` |
| Phase | `.status.phase` |
| Age | `.metadata.creationTimestamp` |
